## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what changes for a user. Link the scoped issue
if one exists. Keep operator presentation, model behavior and biological claims separate.

## Validation

List commands actually run and their results, plus checks not run. State the
source/profile/platform for a measured outcome. Do not turn a prepared plan,
mocked test or screenshot into a live experiment result.

## Review notes

- I have the right to contribute this work under MIT and have preserved applicable third-party notices: <!-- confirm or explain -->
- Documentation or CHANGELOG updates: <!-- links or not applicable -->
- New dependencies, data or changed identities: <!-- scope or none -->
- Remaining limitations: <!-- include unavailable checks and retained failures -->

Please omit credentials, personal absolute paths, raw environment dumps, private
world/player data and bulk artifacts. Logs are optional and should be sanitized.
Use SECURITY.md for sensitive findings. A pull request does not authorize publication.
